samples.question: The black rectangle at the top of the picture is a tray. Inside it are five open boxes drawn as coloured rectangle outlines: one yellow, one red, one green, one blue and one purple. A box is inside another box when its outline is drawn completely within that outline; the box that directly holds it is the smallest box whose outline encloses it, and a box enclosed by no other box sits directly on the tray. Below the grey divider is a row of cream cards. Each card carries two coloured squares with a black arrow pointing from the left square to the right square. A card means: take the box whose colour is on the left, together with everything still inside it, lift it out of wherever it is, and put it directly inside the box whose colour is on the right. The cards are carried out one at a time in order from left to right, as the grey arrow below them shows. Every card shown can be carried out: the target box is never one that is inside the box being moved, and the two colours on a card are never the same. The arrangement after the cards have been carried out is not drawn anywhere. No card ever puts a box back onto the tray, so once every card has been carried out the yellow box is inside at least one other box. After every card has been carried out in order, which box directly holds the yellow box? Answer with one word: red, green, blue or purple.
